incident-bot: 🚨 Detected spike: model=chat-rc variant=rc-1.2 in us-east-1 returning 5xx at 8% (baseline ~0.2%). Auto-alerting on-call @alice_oncall.

alice_oncall: joining call now. paging @bob_sre and @raj_ml_infra for infra/variant context.

bob_sre: on it. quick look at logs -> p99 latency and more transient 500s from rc-1.2 pods. OOMs on a couple replicas earlier, but memory looks stable now.

raj_ml_infra: rc-1.2 had a kernel heuristics change rolled yesterday (kernel v14 -> v15) that toggles attention tiling. seen intermittently in internal perf tests.

carol_support: getting inbound customer reports (ACME id: acct-acme-prod). they see throttle-like errors during heavy bursts. Notifying them that we're triaging.

alice_oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) surgically deprioritize rc-1.2 (move weight -> 0) 2) route new traffic to rc-stable fallback 3) apply short-term per-key rate-slice for heavy keys (acme-*) to limit blast radius 4) capture traces for repro.

bob_sre: executing now. applying routing weight and quota slice. will keep canary snapshot.

bob_sre: ```
# mitigation commands
mitigate set-variant-weight --model chat-rc --variant rc-1.2 --weight 0.0 --reason "emergency deprioritize"
mitigate create-route --model chat-rc --from-variant rc-1.2 --to-variant rc-stable --policy immediate
quotas update --key-pattern "acme-*" --rate 30/s --burst 50 --window 60s --note "emergency slice"
```

deploy-bot: ✅ variant weight updated (rc-1.2 -> 0.0), route created to rc-stable, quota policy applied to keys matching `acme-*`. Changes propagated to us-east-1.

alice_oncall: good. start 15m monitor window. if 5xx falls <0.5% and latency normal, we'll consider gradual reintroduce (5% increments) with close watch.

raj_ml_infra: we've captured a model run with the failing trace and uploaded to /artifacts/incidents/2678901234/ for reproduction. suspect kernel tiling heuristic mismatch with long-prefix KV-cache scenarios.

carol_support: notified ACME account team about the mitigation and that traffic is being routed to rc-stable. they're asking for ETA—told them 30-60m for full stabilization.

emily_product: marking impacted customers and creating a short status note for the public postmortem. adding ACME to priority outreach list.

bob_sre: monitoring dashboards: errors dropped to 0.3% within 5m, p99 latency trending down. continuing watch.

alice_oncall: handing over to @bob_sre for follow-up and rollback decision. I'll sign out of paging. leave the incident channel open for updates. :white_check_mark:

bob_sre: ack. I'll own follow-up, run a controlled reintroduce test after 45m if stable. making a checklist: reproduce locally, confirm kernel rollback candidate, coordinate canary ramps.

incident-bot: pager cleared for alice_oncall, handoff recorded to bob_sre.

bob_sre: creating follow-up ticket INC-2678901234 in tracker with mitigation steps and artifacts link. assigning to raj_ml_infra for root-cause and to devex for rollout guard.

alice_oncall: thanks team — nice quick surgical mitigation.

carol_support: ACME confirmed they see fewer errors now. will keep monitoring.

bob_sre: continuing watch for 3h. will post final update in ~3h or earlier if we reintroduce rc-1.2.

(ends)
